metadata.question: Did the Central Valley of California have a higher water height equivalent in October 2022 than March 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NASA GRACE LAND mascon dataset (NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND) band 'lwe_thickness' to compute monthly equivalent water height over a polygon approximating California’s Central Valley. Periods: Oct 2022 (2022-10-01 to 2022-11-01) vs Mar 2023 (2023-03-01 to 2023-04-01). If no images, expand window by ±30 days.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (GRACE product). Just compute regional mean and valid pixel counts.
3. Validity logic: If collections empty after fallback -> C1. If pixel count after reduction is 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range [-100, 100] cm -> C3. Otherwise compare Oct > Mar => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const centralValley = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[-122.0, 34.8], [-118.0, 34.8], [-118.0, 40.9], [-122.0, 40.9]],
      null, false
    );

    const octStart = ee.Date('2022-10-01');
    const octEnd   = ee.Date('2022-11-01');
    const marStart = ee.Date('2023-03-01');
    const marEnd   = ee.Date('2023-04-01');

    // 2. Data Acquisition (GRACE LAND mascon, liquid water equivalent thickness)
    const baseCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND').select('lwe_thickness');

    function getPeriodStats(label, startDate, endDate, region) {
      let col = baseCol.filterDate(startDate, endDate);
      let n = col.size().getInfo();
      let expanded = false;

      if (n === 0) {
        const start2 = ee.Date(startDate).advance(-30, 'day');
        const end2 = ee.Date(endDate).advance(30, 'day');
        col = baseCol.filterDate(start2, end2);
        n = col.size().getInfo();
        expanded = n > 0;
      }
      if (n === 0) {
        return {label, nImages: 0, expandedTried: true, status: 'C1'};
      }

      const img = col.mean().rename('lwe_thickness');
      const countDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 30000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const count = countDict.get('lwe_thickness').getInfo();
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        return {label, nImages: n, expanded, pixels: 0, status: 'C2'};
      }

      const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 30000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const mean = meanDict.get('lwe_thickness').getInfo();

      if (mean === null || mean === undefined || !isFinite(mean) || mean < -100 || mean > 100) {
        return {label, nImages: n, expanded, pixels: count, mean, status: 'C3'};
      }

      return {label, nImages: n, expanded, pixels: count, mean, status: 'OK'};
    }

    const oct = getPeriodStats('Oct2022', octStart, octEnd, centralValley);
    const mar = getPeriodStats('Mar2023', marStart, marEnd, centralValley);

    // Handle empty collections
    if (oct.status === 'C1' || mar.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`Oct2022 Images: ${oct.nImages || 0}`);
      console.log(`Mar2023 Images: ${mar.nImages || 0}`);
      console.log('At least one period has no images even after expansion.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Handle zero valid pixels
    if (oct.status === 'C2' || mar.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`Oct2022 Images: ${oct.nImages}${oct.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
      console.log(`Mar2023 Images: ${mar.nImages}${mar.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
      console.log('At least one period has 0 valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Handle calculation failures
    if (oct.status === 'C3' || mar.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`Oct2022 Images: ${oct.nImages}${oct.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
      console.log(`Mar2023 Images: ${mar.nImages}${mar.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
      console.log('Computed value is null/NaN or out of plausible range.');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Evidence prints (concise)
    console.log(`Oct2022 Images: ${oct.nImages}${oct.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
    console.log(`Mar2023 Images: ${mar.nImages}${mar.expanded ? ' (expanded)' : ''}`);
    console.log(`Oct2022 Mean lwe_thickness (cm): ${oct.mean.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${oct.pixels}`);
    console.log(`Mar2023 Mean lwe_thickness (cm): ${mar.mean.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${mar.pixels}`);
    console.log(`Difference (Oct - Mar): ${(oct.mean - mar.mean).toFixed(2)} cm`);

    // 4. Final Answer
    if (oct.mean > mar.mean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(String(err).slice(0, 300));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
